scripts.build: npm run build -w @ferweb/contracts && npm run build -w @ferweb/api && npm run build -w @ferweb/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ferweb/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ferweb/contracts && node --import tsx --test apps/api/test/app.test.ts apps/api/test/migrations.test.ts apps/api/test/identity.test.ts apps/api/test/coding-boundaries.test.ts apps/api/test/observability.test.ts apps/api/test/context-ranking.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/api/test/database.integration.ts apps/api/test/workspace.integration.ts apps/api/test/github.integration.ts apps/api/test/chat.integration.ts apps/api/test/retrieval.integration.ts apps/api/test/laboratory.integration.ts apps/api/test/jobs.integration.ts apps/api/test/coding.integration.ts apps/api/test/review.integration.ts apps/api/test/context.integration.ts apps/api/test/memory.integration.ts apps/api/test/context-packs.integration.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests compose*.yaml playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.base.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts tests compose*.yaml playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.base.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
